{"id":1969099423,"question_id":4268,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1775357259,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"147 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1969099423/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Integers With Multiple Sum of Two Cubes","memory":"37.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    \n    vector<int> findGoodIntegers(int n) {\n        vector<int>sum;\n\n        for(ll a = 1 ; a*a*a <= n ; a++){\n            for(ll b = a ; (a*a*a + b*b*b) <= n ; b++){\n                sum.push_back(a*a*a + b*b*b);\n            }\n        }\n\n        sort(begin(sum) , end(sum));\n        vector<int>ans;\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<sum.size() ; i++){\n            if(sum[i] == sum[i-1])\n            {\n                if(ans.empty() or ans.back() != sum[i]) ans.push_back(sum[i]);\n            }\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"integers-with-multiple-sum-of-two-cubes","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1902}
